A reproductive-age female, sexually active without contraception, presents with acute left-sided abdominal pain onset during kickboxing. Menstruation ended 2 days prior. - Quantitative serum β-hCG and progesterone  
- Diagnostic paracentesis of pelvic fluid (for RBC count and β-hCG concentration — a β-hCG level in fluid > maternal serum level is diagnostic of ectopic pregnancy)
